meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你制作 HyperFrames 幻灯片:离散页面、翻页导航、带讲者备注的演示者模式、热点分支跳转,也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可播放、可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片时直接开始;如果请求只是「presentation」「pitch deck」「deck」等相邻说法,Claude 会先问你确认再动手。

say.text: 把这个页面转成一套可翻页的幻灯片,保留原来的设计和动效
say.note: Claude 会先确认,再按源页面保真转换

say.text: 给这套幻灯片加上讲者备注和演示者模式
say.note: 备注只给讲者看,观众看不到

say.text: 在第三页加一个热点,点它跳到市场规模的补充分支
say.note: 热点绑定到 slideSequences 里的分支

howto.what_en: Installing it makes Claude author a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, navigation, presenter mode with speaker notes, hotspot branching, and converting an existing page into a deck. The output is a runnable, navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: It starts when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. If the request is only an adjacent term such as "presentation", "pitch deck" or "convert this page", Claude asks you to confirm first.

say_en.text: Turn this page into a navigable slide deck, keeping its design and motion
say_en.note: Claude confirms first, then ports with source fidelity

say_en.text: Add speaker notes and presenter mode to this deck
say_en.note: Notes stay presenter-only, hidden from the audience

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide three that jumps to the market-sizing branch
say_en.note: The hotspot targets a branch in slideSequences
